items.q: What should you remember about **Two realities**?
items.a: **Apes' GameStop is a cosmic battle** for generational wealth; yours is a struggling mall retailer that got a temporary lifeline.

items.q: What should you remember about **January was complicated**?
items.a: **SEC report**: short squeeze elements + massive retail FOMO; Melvin lost big (Citadel bailout); bag holders were mostly retail, not Citadel.

items.q: What should you remember about **Post-squeeze coping**?
items.a: **Recast January as "the sneeze";** MOASS becomes the real event; infinite risk/reward rhetoric masks negative EV.

items.q: What should you remember about **Conspiracy injection timeline**?
items.a: Naked shorts, DRS, DTCC, Ken Griffin letters mattered little in January but exploded Feb–Mar as **why it didn't keep squeezing**.

items.q: What should you remember about **DRS as religion**?
items.a: **Direct registration reframed as proof of** float ownership; ComputerShare "heat lamp burger" posts as low-effort lore that still spreads.

items.q: What should you remember about **Robinhood mundane read**?
items.a: **Limited margin / collateral** mechanics vs Apes' "targeted disruption" narrative; still catalyzed persecution complex.

items.q: What should you remember about **Keith Gill paradox**?
items.a: **Inventor of meme stocks to** some, meaningless mascot to the documentary's causal story; silence interpreted conspiratorially.

items.q: What should you remember about **Gambling + soap opera**?
items.a: **Daily price drama + community belonging;** hide losses from spouses; "wife-changing money" meme (dividend fantasy on one share).

items.q: What should you remember about **Due diligence theater**?
items.a: **Research volume without falsifiability;** mods, shills, paid opposition as permanent narrative furniture.

items.q: What should you remember about **Regulatory nightmare**?
items.a: **Enough collective inertia to move prices** + enough delusion to misread basic mechanics = no easy policy response.

items.q: What should you remember about **Winners irony**?
items.a: **Retail heroes narrative vs hedge** funds farming predictable irrationality (WSB recruiting, dilution "tasty dip" plays).

items.q: What should you remember about **Title punchline**?
items.a: **Ironic "financial advice" from** a movement that redefines finance into a quasi-religious siege.
